canonical_model.display_name: LungAI DenseNet-121 — Six-Class Chest X-Ray Classifier

evidence_level: RECORDED: aggregate results from earlier runs. Threshold metrics are checked for internal consistency against the stored confusion matrices. They cannot be reproduced: no checkpoint, image or per-image prediction is in the repository. The internal test split has known patient leakage (see artifacts/data_validation).

recorded_unverifiable.reason: needs per-image probabilities, which were never saved

external.cohort: Montgomery County (external, binary TB vs normal)

binary_abnormality.definition: positive = predicted class is not 'Normal'; reference positive = TB-confirmed scan

external.interpretation: Degenerate: every scan, including every normal scan, was predicted abnormal. Sensitivity 58/58 carries no screening value with specificity 0/80.

validation_evidence.what: Filter chosen on validation: the ERM baseline checkpoint evaluated on val under 10 preprocessing filters; Gaussian sigma=1.0 had the highest val macro-F1 (0.8457 vs 0.7495 unfiltered). The trained model's own validation score was logged but not saved.
